notes.title: Road Food Simulator Prologue Hotfix 5
notes.content:
[h2]Road Food Simulator Prologue Hotfix 5[/h2]

* Customer visit speeds for Single Player and Multiplayer games have been made different.

[h2]Don't forget to add it to your wishlist for Road Food Simulator Full version![/h2]

[h3]In the full version:[/h3]

* You will be able to make 15 different great pizzas with Mushrooms, Sausages, Bacon and many other pizza toppings.

* You will be able to offer new beverages to your customers and make profit.

* You will be able to expand your pizza empire by hiring employees such as Waiters, Waitresses, Cashiers.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3207670/Road_Food_Simulator
